Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice M.Nagaprasanna
 Oral Order

The petitioner/accused No.1 in Crl.P.No.9304 of 2024, call in question proceedings in C.C.No.9563 of 2023 arising out of Crime No.353 of 2022, Bangalore registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506 of the IPC and under NC: 2024:KHC:37002 Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

Petitioners/accused Nos.2 to 6 in Crl.P.No.1004/2023, call in question proceedings in Crime No.353 of 2022 for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 504,
506, 149 of the IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 pending on the file of 37th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Bangalore.

They have filed separate applications under Section 320(2) of the Cr.P.C., seeking to compound the offences.

A joint affidavit is also filed in this regard by the accused No.1 and the complainant, which reads as follows:
"JOINT AFFIDVAIT I Shaik Amjad Pasha, S/o Late Munavar Pasha Aged about 32 years, Residing at: 307, JP Nagar, 9th Phase, Near Madeena Masjid, Avalahalli Anjanapura Post Bangalore, Karnataka- 560062 and I Zaiba M W/o Shaik Amjad Pasha Aged about 25 years Residing at: 160, 30th main 28th cross BTB Area Tilak Nagar Jayanagar Bangalore- 560041 NC: 2024:KHC:37002 1.
I Shaik Amjad Pasha, accused/petitioner no1 in the above case and I am fully conversant with the facts of the case and I am swearing to this affidavit on behalf of accused petitioner no 2-5 also.

2. I Zaiba M I am the complainant in the above case and I am fully conversant with the facts of the case and I am swearing to this affidavit.

sentences.text: 3. We submit that, we have filed an application u/s 320(2) CRPC to compound the offences in the above criminal petition.
4. We submitted that; we have already taken divorce by virture of Khulanama.
5. We submit that, we have settled our disputes and matter has been compromised between us in the presence of the well-wisher.
6. We submit that, we have settled our disputes with own will and wish without any influence or force.
What is stated above is true and correct to the best of my knowledge, information and belief.

wherefore it is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble may please to :
1. Allow application filed u/s 320 of CRPC and permit the parties compound the offences.
2. Pleased to quash the entire proceeding in CC NO 9563/2023 (Crime No 353/2022 arise from PCR No 16635/2022) punishable under sections 498(A), 504, 506 IPC and section 4 of D P Act registered by the respondent police i.e Basavanagudi Women's Police station pending on the file of Hon'ble 37th Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate Court Bangalore the interest of justice and equity."
NC: 2024:KHC:37002 4.
In the light of the compromise arrived at between the parties as afore-quoted and the offence alleged not being against the State or Society, the applications filed are taken on record.
The parties are permitted to compromise the matters.
Accordingly, proceedings pending against all the petitioners require to be obliterated.

5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER (i) Criminal Petitions are disposed.

(ii) The crime registered in Crime No.353 of 2022 and all further proceedings pending in C.C.No.9563 of 2023 pending on the file of 37th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Bangalore stand quashed.
